metaTitle: Landscaping SEO for Lawn Care and Landscape Companies
metaDescription: Landscaping SEO from ASP: service pages for the jobs worth most, Business Profile work and technical fixes, timed to your season and measured on booked jobs.

hero.subhead: SEO aimed at the lawn care, install and snow removal searches in your service area. ASP builds the pages, profile and site health, and reports on booked jobs.
points: Pages built in order of job value
Content live before your season starts
No bought links or Domain Authority scores

why.heading: Why one services page isn't enough
why.intro: Mowing, tree planting, walkways and retaining walls are different jobs with different buyers. A single catch-all page can't answer all of them well.

cards.title: Map rankings can't be bought
cards.body: Google names relevance, distance and prominence as the main local ranking factors, and says a better ranking can't be paid for. Your profile and pages must match what you sell.

cards.title: Ready before the rush
cards.body: According to BLS, grounds maintenance workers may be busier from spring through fall. So spring pages and seasonal content go live before the rush, not halfway through it.

cards.title: Experience only you have
cards.body: We interview you or a senior crew lead for what a typical job costs and why a cheap install fails, then build it into the pages.

services.heading: What landscaping SEO includes
services.intro: The organic work ASP runs for lawn, landscape and snow removal companies.

cards.title: Service page clusters
cards.body: A main service page plus its cost breakdown, method comparison and seasonal problem, built in order of what a booked job is worth to you.

cards.title: Business Profile and local
cards.body: Profile setup inside Google's service-area rules, citations, review capture and a local ranking heatmap so you can see where you show up.

cards.title: Technical fixes first
cards.body: Indexing problems, redirect chains and slow mobile pages get fixed in order of what they cost you, before new content goes in.

cards.title: Seasonal content schedule
cards.body: Content built out over months, with spring services and snow removal pages published ahead of their seasons.

cards.title: Credentials on the page
cards.body: Show the licenses and certifications buyers look for on the pages where they matter.

cards.title: Booked-job reporting
cards.body: Rankings show movement, calls and forms show interest, and booked jobs show whether it paid. That's what your monthly review covers.

steps.title: Research and audit
steps.body: What homeowners search, what those jobs are worth once booked, and what the ranking companies have that you don't.

steps.title: Unblock the site
steps.body: Indexing and crawl problems that cost you jobs get fixed before anything new is written.

steps.title: Build for the season
steps.body: Pages for your highest-value services go live first, timed ahead of your busy months.

steps.title: Report on booked work
steps.body: A monthly review shows what moved, what it booked and what gets built next.

pricing.heading: How landscaping SEO is packaged
pricing.subhead: There's no separate SEO rate card. Organic SEO is included from Foundation up, and it covers service pages, content and technical fixes.

faqs.question: How long does landscaping SEO take to work?
faqs.answer: There's no honest fixed timeline. It depends on your site's history, technical debt and local competition. Technical fixes tend to show first, page changes next, and new content clusters move slowest but hold longest.

faqs.question: Do I need a Business Profile for every town I serve?
faqs.answer: No. A service-area business without a storefront gets one profile under Google's rules. Extra profiles are for separate locations with their own staff and service areas. Individual towns are covered by your service area settings and your website.

faqs.question: Should snow removal get its own page?
faqs.answer: If you sell it, yes. It's a different service, season and buying decision than lawn care. We publish it before winter so it's ready when homeowners start searching.

faqs.question: Do you build backlinks?
faqs.answer: No. ASP doesn't buy links or sell link packages. Links earned from useful pages, real partnerships and local PR are welcome, and they come from the work itself.

faqs.question: Is this the same as Local SEO Pro?
faqs.answer: Local SEO Pro is the local half: your Business Profile, citations, heatmap and rankings. Landscaping SEO adds the service pages, content and technical work on your site. Most clients need both, and they report together.

cta.heading: Get your pages ready for spring
cta.body: Book a call and we'll go through what's indexed, what ranks and which landscaping searches your competitors own. You keep the findings either way.
